zk.hero_title: The soul of the fruit becomes the fruit of the soul.
zk.hero_sub: Premium fruit brandy from the Ér Valley — 22 medals and two champion titles at Central Europe's largest pálinka competition. Single-varietal grape, wild-fruit and oak-aged spirits.
zk.tier_core_d: Apple, plum, grape — the everyday pálinka.
zk.tier_varietal_d: Seven single-varietal grape spirits: Fetească Neagră, Fetească Regală, Irsai Olivér, Muscat Ottonel, Pinot Gris, Chardonnay.
zk.tier_wild_d: Blueberry, blackberry, raspberry — 20–25 kg of fruit per litre.
zk.tier_champion_d: Barrique apple, wild sour cherry, Fetească Neagră Strong, wine distillate, Izabella pomace.
zk.shop_sub: Free delivery over 250 lei within Romania. We do not sell alcohol to anyone under 18.
zk.story_p1: Nagy Botond is from Săcueni. A champion wood-chopper, he represented Romania at world events and coached the national team. He started distilling at home, as everyone does in the Ér Valley — then in 2014 took his first sample to a Hungarian competition, and lost.
zk.story_p2: The judges told him what was wrong. He took the pálinka-judge course, rebuilt his fermentation and distillation, and in 2018 won his first Hungarian medal. In autumn 2020 the hobby became a company, in 2021 a brand: Zekulhyda, the name of Săcueni around the year 1200.
zk.story_p3: Today he sits on the international juries of Quintessence and ÁKOVITA, founded the Ér Valley Pálinka Culture Association, and hosts the judging of the Blisseva Partium Spirits Award in his own tasting room. At Quintessence 2025 he brought home 22 medals from 22 samples and two champion titles; in 2026 he became Grape Variety Master.
zk.story_quote: “Confirmation that we are on the right path — uncompromising quality is our duty.”

zk.tier_barrique_d: Distillates aged in oak barrique and finished in sherry casks: apple, plum, quince, grape, pomace. 0.5 l.

zk.range_sub: Classic pálinka in 0.35 l bottles, the Barrique and Distilat series in 0.5 l. Small batches, no added sugar or flavouring — fruit from within 30 km, citrus excepted.
zk.bq_p: Five distillates aged in oak barrique, then given their final polish in sherry casks. The apple is the 2025 category champion — the others are next years' contenders.
zk.story_title: The man who lost first, so he could start learning.

zk.ds_p: Seven clean distillates from citrus, banana and ginger — 42%, 0.5 l, in the ribbed blue bottle. Not a liqueur, not a flavouring: real fruit, distilled. Neat, on ice or with tonic — for younger guests and for bar counters.
